text: Boxes app lets you pick an OS and automatically creates a virtual machine
quote: Boxes takes the guesswork out of using virtual machines. Just select the OS you want to install, and the app will do the rest.

text: Comes with container tools ready to use, no setup needed, including access to Red Hat's registry
quote: Use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem. No setup required. Access the Red Hat container registry.

text: Provides all needed packages, tools and runtimes ready to use with a single command
quote: All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.

text: Includes a performance mode toggle to boost hardware speed on demand
quote: Use performance mode to boost hardware speed when you need it.

text: Do Not Disturb mode silences notifications
quote: Turn off notifications with Do Not Disturb.

text: Press Super key and type to instantly search apps, files and settings
quote: Press the Super key and just type to search for what you need.

text: Dark mode and night light can be toggled to reduce eye strain
quote: Flip a switch to turn on dark mode and give your eyes a break. Or use night light to reduce screen glare and help with sleep.

text: One-click installation of desktop apps from Fedora repositories, Flathub, or other sources
quote: Easily install the very best desktop apps with the click of a button from Fedora's repositories, Flathub or anywhere else.

text: Can connect online accounts to bring calendar, contacts and data into the desktop
quote: Optionally, bring your online calendar, contacts and data to the desktop with online accounts.

text: Available in many languages thanks to a community translation effort
quote: Thanks to a global community of translators, Workstation is available in many languages.

text: Ships with built-in utility apps like Clocks, Weather and Maps
quote: Fedora Workstation includes a great set of utilities, like Clocks, Weather and Maps.
